blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Irvine
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Irvine is a sprawling, car-dependent planned city where distances are long and there is no walkable nightlife grid between venues.
UCI commencement and major campus events create enormous parking demand that a chauffeured vehicle bypasses entirely.
Irvine Spectrum plus the surrounding hotel cluster, including Irvine Marriott and Hyatt Regency Irvine, is a natural party-bus loop.
SNA is a short drive away and is the most convenient airport in Orange County for executives and wedding guests.
I-405, SR 55, SR 133 and the 73 Toll Road let one coach reach Laguna Beach, Newport Beach and San Diego-area venues in a single day.

blocks.text: We also quote Irvine to the hour rather than the trip. blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Irvine Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.

blocks.text: Licensed, Insured, and Backup Plans

Every chauffeur on our team is licensed and background checked, and our vehicles are licensed and inspected. Our drivers work the night and do not drink, which matters when the group includes teenagers, and we set a fixed return time off the venue's posted close so nobody is standing in a parking lot at 1 AM wondering where the car went.
